ja334:1.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti nette jimhagate sati.
ja334:2.1: Evam eva manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce adhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukkhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti adhammiko.
ja334:3.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ ujuṃ gacchati puṅgavo sabbā tā ujuṃ gacchanti nette ujuṃgate sati.
ja334:4.1: Evam eva manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce pi dhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sukhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti dhammiko ti.
